degree_rationale: Extended teaching on how the cosmos was fashioned in the form of the human body — head, neck, heart, thighs, knees, feet mapped to firmaments, sphere, air, lands, omophore. The Watchers, the seven cosmoses of the body, the twelve zodiac-signs distributed left and right, the 840 myriads of head-archons. The natural body-cosmos correspondence par excellence.
direction_rationale: The originating natural mapping — the body as cosmic microcosm, every limb assigned its corresponding sphere. East = the foundational natural correspondence-map.
grand_man_function: Natural cosmos-as-body — the foundational correspondence of human limbs to cosmic regions.
title: How the cosmos was fashioned in the form of the human body (extended)
